For additional information please review our Privacy Policy and our Accessibility Statement.
notes: UPDATE after the network opened at about 14:07 UTC: harrisvotes.com became reachable through the fetch module and the earlier blocked attempts were superseded. Results site: the Live Results page (harrisvotes.com/Election-Results/Live-Results) embeds the county's own election-day app at https://app.harrisvotes.com/electionresults/electionday (title 'Election Day Results - Election Division'), an AngularJS page that loads JSON from https://appfiles.harrisvotes.com/harrisvotes/prd/Data/<electionCode>/ (resultsbyballot.json, pr.json, pv-<contest>.json); electionCode is currently '1126'. Platform is therefore homegrown (county-built app and data host), not a vendor ENR. The app template has a per-contest 'Precinct Reporting' tab that loads pv-<contest>.json, and pr.json lists precincts; Data/1124/pr.json still exists with Last-Modified 'Fri, 15 Nov 2024 18:01:45 GMT' (canvass time), while Data/0326/pr.json and Data/0526/pr.json return 404. This shows the live app can display precinct-level results and was updated through canvass, but does not show whether the precinct tab was populated during election night for Nov 5 2024, Mar 3 2026, or May 26 2026; treated as a strong lead only. The Archives page lists, per election, a 'Cumulative Report' and a 'Canvass Report' (for example Nov 5 2024 cumulative at appfiles.harrisvotes.com/harrisvotes/prd/Data/1124/cumulative.pdf and 'FINAL Official Canvass Results-11-14-2024 03-12-57 PM.pdf'; Mar 3 2026 canvass reports dated 3-10-2026); no election-night precinct report is archived. The Election Reports page lists reconciliation reports, not precinct results. Contact: harrisvotes.com/Contact-Us shows 'Phone: 713-755-6965', '15600 Morales Road, Houston, TX 77032', and an 'Email:' link (Cloudflare-obfuscated) decoding to voters@harrisvotes.com; the TX SOS county election officials list gives Harris County Clerk Teneshia E. Hudspeth, (713) 755-6965, County Email Address mailto voters@vote.hctx.net. Usage notice: the results pages carry this site-wide footer disclaimer verbatim (recorded in usage_notice_text); it is a liability disclaimer, not a redistribution restriction. Earlier (pre-14:07 UTC) attempts: fetch module to harrisvotes.com/Contact-Us and /Election-Results failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable, proxy 403); Wayback probe for appfiles.harrisvotes.com/harrisvotes/prd/Data/ failed for all three windows; WebFetch to fox26houston.com, votebeat.org and ballotpedia.org were EGRESS_BLOCKED. Search leads: the search summary's 713-755-6965 is now confirmed on the county page; '240 out of 275 voting precinct reporting as of the morning of March 4' (communityimpact.com) is a reporting-progress count, not precinct-level results. No 2025 or 2026 stated change to precinct-level reporting found.
tag_rationale: The county's homegrown live results app has a precinct reporting tab, but no source shows when precinct-level data appeared on election night for the three target elections; archived precinct detail is the canvass report.
